title: Fair Enough: Standardizing Evaluation and Model Selection for Fairness Research in NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating group-wise fairness by calculating True Positive Rate (TPR) disparities (gap and ratio) across binary gender groups (male vs. female) on a biography classification task (BIOS dataset).
Evaluating True Positive Rate (TPR) disparities across economic status groups (wealthy vs. rest of world, determined by geotagged home countries) on a biography classification task.
